question: Can the variance of scaled attention logits serve as an online precursor of grokking, and does increasing AdamW weight decay in response to that signal accelerate generalization beyond what an equally strong signal-free regularization schedule would achieve?

key_findings.claim: The proposed attention specific heat is the variance of scaled query-key logits, not a heat capacity independently derived or calibrated in this paper.
key_findings.evidence: Equation 2 defines C_v = Var(QK^T/sqrt(d_k)) by adopting an attention-temperature correspondence from Kim (2026). The paper does not derive C_v as a derivative of energy with respect to temperature, specify a finite-size scaling law, or test a thermodynamic singularity.

key_findings.claim: CvAdamW is a memorization-gated feedback controller that increases weight decay when an exponentially smoothed positive C_v velocity exceeds a threshold.
key_findings.evidence: Equations 4-6 use alpha = 0.9, base weight decay 0.1, and lambda_t = lambda_base + kappa max(0, mu_t - tau); actuation begins only after training accuracy reaches 0.99.

key_findings.claim: The z-score controller replaces kappa and tau, but its successful form still depends on a consequential cold-start convention and several fixed design choices.
key_findings.evidence: Equations 7-10 set z_thresh = 2 and retain the accuracy gate, EMA statistics, epsilon, and base decay. The cold-start variant initializes mean and variance only after the gate opens; the continuous-statistics variant tracks them from epoch 1 and does not show the paired benefit.

key_findings.claim: The development narrative reports three failed detector designs rather than a monotone relationship between C_v and impending generalization.
key_findings.evidence: Ungated detectors fired at epoch 16 and performed worse than baseline; an unsmoothed trigger fired on a one-epoch ripple at epoch 240; and a slingshot-associated training-accuracy drop closed the gate during a large C_v spike. These observations motivated gating, EMA smoothing, and continuous actuation.

anchors.section: Section 7, Negative results and design lessons

key_findings.claim: All intervention evidence comes from one small modular-addition configuration.
key_findings.evidence: The study uses all 9,409 pairs for (a+b) mod 97 with a 50/50 split, a two-layer decoder-only Transformer with d_model = 128, four heads, d_k = 32, RoPE and GELU, and AdamW with learning rate 3e-4, base decay 0.1, and batch size 512.

key_findings.claim: Controller development and evaluation reuse the same task, with small and differing seed sets and budgets rather than a task-level holdout.
key_findings.evidence: The kappa/tau study uses five seeds for 10,000 epochs, the scale-invariant study uses ten specified seeds for 7,000 epochs, and the illustrative comparison is truncated at 4,000 epochs. No held-out modulus, operation, architecture, or controller-selection split is evaluated.

key_findings.claim: In the single illustrative run, continuous CvAdamW crosses 0.95 validation accuracy at epoch 2,802 and a one-shot step intervention at 3,333, while fixed-decay AdamW does not cross within 4,000 epochs.
key_findings.evidence: The step trigger detects a peak at epoch 3,049 and crosses 284 epochs later; continuous CvAdamW reaches a peak weight decay of 1.61 and crosses first. This comparison demonstrates an in-budget difference for one run, not that the baseline can never grok.

key_findings.claim: Across ten paired seeds, cold-start z-score CvAdamW reduces mean grokking epoch from 4,313 to 4,056, a 257-epoch or 6.0% mean improvement, with eight wins and two regressions.
key_findings.evidence: Tables 1-2 report a median improvement of 166 epochs; seeds 2048 and 3141 improve by 781 and 1,023 epochs, whereas seeds 123 and 1024 regress by 140 and 120 epochs.

key_findings.claim: The ten-seed statistical evidence is borderline and changes conclusion across reasonable paired tests.
key_findings.evidence: The two-sided Wilcoxon test gives p = 0.049 and the bootstrap 95% interval is [53, 489], but the paired t-test gives p = 0.060, the sign test p = 0.109, and the classical 95% interval is [-13, 527]. The paper reports all tests, but provides no multiplicity adjustment or held-out replication.

key_findings.claim: Accumulating z-score statistics continuously erases the average improvement, making sensor initialization part of the intervention rather than an implementation detail.
key_findings.evidence: Table 1 gives mean grokking epochs of 4,313 for baseline, 4,056 for cold-start, and 4,333 for continuous statistics. Continuous statistics are 20 epochs slower than baseline on average and win only about half the seeds.

key_findings.claim: A retrospectively located post-memorization C_v peak precedes grokking in all ten baseline runs but does not predict when grokking occurs.
key_findings.evidence: The mean lead is 2,400 epochs with standard deviation 974 and median 2,396. Peak epoch has Pearson r = -0.099 (p = 0.79) and Spearman rho = 0.055 (p = 0.88) with grokking epoch.

key_findings.claim: The precursor result is not a prospective online forecasting evaluation.
key_findings.evidence: The analysis locates the peak on each complete EMA-smoothed trajectory after memorization, despite earlier documented nuisance peaks. It reports no frozen past-only detector, false-positive rate, forecast horizon, calibration curve, or evaluation on runs that fail to grok within the observation window.

key_findings.claim: The experiments do not isolate information in C_v from the generic effect of stronger late weight decay.
key_findings.evidence: Dynamic decay reaches about 0.8-1.1 for the z-score variant and 1.5-2.6 for the kappa/tau version versus the fixed 0.1 baseline. There is no fixed-high-decay arm, replayed or shuffled trigger, alternative-signal trigger, or schedule matched for cumulative parameter shrinkage.

key_findings.claim: The fixed-epoch comparison does not establish a fully fixed compute budget because attention monitoring overhead is unreported.
key_findings.evidence: CvAdamW must capture and aggregate attention logits each epoch in addition to ordinary AdamW updates. The paper matches epoch, data, and model budgets but gives no wall-clock, memory, or extra-operation accounting, and it does not specify the aggregation over heads, layers, examples, and batches.

key_findings.claim: The paper supplies no theorem that C_v-targeted decay accelerates grokking and no finite-size evidence for a thermodynamic phase transition.
key_findings.evidence: The paper presents controller equations and finite-run curves at one modulus and one model size. It varies neither an extensive system size nor a thermodynamic control parameter and derives no causal link from Equation 2 to reduced grokking time.

key_findings.claim: The paper explicitly leaves signal uniqueness, portability, and scale transfer unresolved.
key_findings.evidence: The limitations call for larger seed counts, language and vision tests, threshold adaptation, and head-to-head comparisons against attention entropy, weight norm, gradient norm, and loss derivatives; future work also asks for other moduli, operations, ablations, and schedule controls.

method.core_idea: Use attention-logit variance as a training-state sensor and increase AdamW weight decay when its post-memorization velocity becomes anomalously positive.
method.mechanism: The optimizer measures C_v = Var(QK^T/sqrt(d_k)) once per epoch, differentiates it over epochs, smooths or standardizes the velocity, gates actuation on training accuracy at least 0.99, and raises weight decay above 0.1 in proportion to the threshold excess.
assumptions: A consistently aggregated variance of attention logits is a meaningful scalar state variable across batches, heads, and layers, although that aggregation is not fully specified.
A positive post-memorization C_v velocity identifies a causally useful regime rather than an initialization, minibatch, or optimizer transient.
Increasing weight decay at the detected time helps because the signal locates a transition, not merely because stronger late regularization often accelerates grokking.
The 0.99 memorization gate, EMA constants, z-score threshold 2, epsilon, and cold-start convention transfer beyond the development task.
The attention-temperature analogy remains operationally meaningful in this finite model even without a demonstrated thermodynamic limit.

techniques.role: Supplies the proposed specific-heat sensor from scaled query-key logits.
Prevents regularization actuation before training accuracy reaches 0.99.
Maps sustained positive C_v motion to proportional AdamW weight decay.
Standardizes post-gate sensor velocity while excluding pre-memorization history.
Compares grokking epochs for the same ten seeds under fixed and adaptive decay.
Measures how far a full-trajectory post-memorization C_v maximum precedes grokking.

evaluations.setting: One modular-addition run under a 4,000-epoch cap (Section 6.1; Figures 2-3).
evaluations.metric: First epoch with validation accuracy above 0.95 and peak applied weight decay.
evaluations.result: Continuous CvAdamW groks at epoch 2,802 with peak decay 1.61; the detected step trigger at epoch 3,049 groks at 3,333; fixed decay does not cross within the cap.
evaluations.baseline: AdamW with fixed weight decay 0.1. This is one seed and is neither a tuned-high-decay nor cumulative-shrinkage-matched baseline.

evaluations.setting: Ten specified paired seeds on (a+b) mod 97 for 7,000 epochs (Section 6.3; Tables 1-2).
evaluations.metric: Paired grokking epoch, mean and median difference, wins, and paired effect sizes.
evaluations.result: Mean changes from 4,313 to 4,056; mean gain is 257 epochs (6.0%), median gain 166 (4.3%), wins 8/10, paired Cohen d 0.68, rank-biserial r 0.71, and Cliff delta 0.22.
evaluations.baseline: The same seeds under fixed weight decay 0.1; two seeds regress by 140 and 120 epochs.

evaluations.setting: Alternative inferential analyses of the ten paired differences (Section 6.3; Table 2).
evaluations.metric: Two-sided Wilcoxon, paired t-test, sign test, bootstrap and classical 95% confidence intervals.
evaluations.result: Wilcoxon p = 0.049 and bootstrap interval [53, 489] exclude the null boundary, whereas t-test p = 0.060, sign-test p = 0.109, and classical interval [-13, 527] do not.
evaluations.baseline: A zero paired improvement; no correction for multiple reported analyses or independent replication is supplied.

evaluations.setting: Cold-start versus continuous z-score statistics across the same ten seeds (Section 6.3; Table 1).
evaluations.metric: Mean grokking epoch and per-seed paired outcomes.
evaluations.result: Continuous statistics average 4,333 epochs, 20 later than baseline and 277 later than cold-start; the favorable result depends on excluding pre-gate sensor history.
evaluations.baseline: Fixed AdamW and cold-start statistics with the same nominal z-score rule.

evaluations.metric: Lead from retrospective post-memorization C_v maximum to grokking and correlation of peak epoch with grokking epoch.
evaluations.result: All 10 peaks precede grokking; mean lead is 2,400 +/- 974 epochs and median 2,396, but Pearson r = -0.099 (p = 0.79) and Spearman rho = 0.055 (p = 0.88).
evaluations.baseline: No prospective detector, negative-run cohort, alternative signal, or forecast-calibration baseline.

evaluations.result: The z-score formulation reaches about 0.8-1.1, whereas the tuned kappa/tau formulation reaches 1.5-2.6 and is described as more effective on this task.
evaluations.baseline: Fixed 0.1 decay; schedule dose and total shrinkage are not matched, so signal quality and intervention strength remain entangled.

limitations: Author-stated: all results use one modular-addition task and one small two-layer Transformer; language, vision, architecture, and scale transfer are untested.
Author-stated: n = 10 gives limited power, the statistical tests disagree, and C_v peak time does not predict grokking time.
Author-stated: C_v is not compared against attention entropy, parameter norms, gradient statistics, or loss derivatives, so signal uniqueness is unknown.
Author-stated: the ostensibly task-agnostic z-score threshold may still require adaptation on different problems.
Reviewer-identified: no fixed-high, replayed, randomized, shuffled, alternative-signal, or cumulative-shrinkage-matched schedule isolates the causal value of C_v.
Reviewer-identified: iterative controller selection and final evaluation occur on the same task, without a task-level development/test split.
Reviewer-identified: attention-logit aggregation across samples, batches, heads, and layers and its wall-clock or memory overhead are insufficiently specified.
Reviewer-identified: full-trajectory peak selection is retrospective and supplies no prospective false-positive, precision, recall, calibration, or censoring analysis.
Reviewer-identified: no finite-size scaling, order parameter, susceptibility test, or theorem establishes a thermodynamic transition or a causal heating mechanism.
failure_modes: Initialization transients can activate an ungated detector before a memorized state exists and can make intervention worse than baseline.
One-epoch minibatch ripples can cross a raw velocity threshold and waste a discrete intervention.
Slingshot-associated training-accuracy drops can close the gate at a large C_v peak.
Continuous pre-gate statistics can dilute the post-memorization anomaly and eliminate the average benefit.
Large adaptive weight decay can delay grokking for individual seeds.
A past-only detector may mistake a local nuisance peak for the global peak identifiable only in hindsight.
The signal scale or aggregation can shift with width, head count, task, or batching, breaking threshold portability.
Monitoring attention logits can erase some fixed-epoch savings when wall-clock or memory, rather than epochs, is the resource.
reusable_insights: Evaluate an online progress measure with frozen past-only features and decision rules; a future-selected maximum is not a forecast.
Adaptive-regularization studies should include replayed, shuffled, randomized, fixed-dose, and cumulative-shrinkage-matched controls.
Controller-state initialization is a substantive treatment factor and should be preregistered and ablated.
Paired seeds reduce grokking-time variance, but task-level replication is still required for portability claims.
A useful precursor can be qualitatively early yet quantitatively uninformative about remaining time.
Reserve phase-transition language for observables with a specified thermodynamic limit or finite-size diagnostic chain.
open_questions: Does a frozen, past-only C_v detector add predictive value over validation loss, attention entropy, weight norms, gradients, and spectral measures on held-out moduli and seeds?
Does CvAdamW retain an advantage over fixed and replayed decay schedules matched for total parameter shrinkage and wall-clock compute?
Which exact aggregation over examples, batches, heads, and layers yields a reproducible C_v, and how expensive is it?
How sensitive are results to the 0.99 gate, EMA constants, z_thresh = 2, epsilon, batch size, and grokking threshold?
Can a prospective controller handle censored runs that never grok within budget without accumulating false triggers?
Does the intervention accelerate real language or vision generalization rather than only a threshold crossing on modular arithmetic?
Can modulus, width, depth, or dataset fraction scaling distinguish a singular transition from a smooth finite-size crossover?

competitive_landscape.title: Thermodynamic Isomorphism of Transformers: A Lagrangian Approach to Attention Dynamics
competitive_landscape.difference: Kim supplies the attention-temperature and fluctuation framing used by CvAdamW. Its revised abstract explicitly describes finite-size crossover behavior without asymptotic power-law divergence; CvAdamW adds feedback control but does not resolve that qualification.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v2, updated 2026-02-13T05:45:50Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets
competitive_landscape.difference: Power et al. establish delayed generalization and its dataset-size dependence. CvAdamW proposes a state-dependent regularization intervention but evaluates one descendant modular-addition setting.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v1, updated 2022-01-06T18:43:37Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Omnigrok: Grokking Beyond Algorithmic Data
competitive_landscape.difference: Omnigrok connects grokking across algorithmic and non-algorithmic tasks to loss-versus-weight-norm geometry and weight decay. CvAdamW does not compare its C_v trigger with that norm-based mechanism or a tuned signal-free decay schedule.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v2, updated 2023-03-23T13:42:27Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Progress measures for grokking via mechanistic interpretability
competitive_landscape.difference: Nanda et al. derive task-specific circuit progress measures and distinguish memorization, circuit formation, and cleanup. CvAdamW offers a cheaper scalar proxy but does not test prospective incremental prediction against those mechanistic measures.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v3, updated 2023-10-19T21:25:32Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: The Slingshot Mechanism: An Empirical Study of Adaptive Optimizers and the Grokking Phenomenon
competitive_landscape.difference: Thilak et al. connect grokking to cyclic late-stage adaptive-optimizer instability. CvAdamW documents slingshot blinding but does not separate C_v motion from optimizer-state cycles.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v2, updated 2022-06-13T04:18:16Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Grokking as a First Order Phase Transition in Two Layer Networks
competitive_landscape.difference: This work analytically maps feature learning in tractable teacher-student models to a first-order transition and identifies a mixed phase. CvAdamW uses a finite-run attention-variance peak without a comparable order parameter or phase derivation.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v3, updated 2024-05-05T12:21:36Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Information-Theoretic Progress Measures reveal Grokking is an Emergent Phase Transition
competitive_landscape.difference: This paper uses higher-order mutual information to identify pre-grokking phases and studies effects of weight decay and initialization. CvAdamW neither compares forecast quality against it nor shows C_v contains distinct information.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v1, updated 2024-08-16T16:33:46Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Grokking as a Falsifiable Finite-Size Transition
competitive_landscape.difference: Bi et al. vary group order, use a representation-level order parameter, Binder-like crossings, and susceptibility model comparison. That is substantially stronger evidence for phase-transition language than CvAdamW's one-size attention peak, though it does not propose an online optimizer.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v1, updated 2026-03-25T19:15:27Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: From Density Matrices to Phase Transitions in Deep Learning: Spectral Early Warnings and Interpretability
competitive_landscape.difference: Hennick et al. derive spectral heat-capacity and participation-ratio signals from a two-datapoint reduced density matrix and evaluate four transition settings. CvAdamW is narrower and does not compare prospective warning accuracy or intervention value.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v2, updated 2026-04-01T10:40:57Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Grokking on the Weight-Decay Clock: A Rate Hierarchy from Softly Broken Symmetries
competitive_landscape.difference: Kim derives an exact late-time weight-decay relaxation law in a solvable model, distinguishes coupled L2 from decoupled decay, and tests predicted time scaling on modular addition. It postdates CvAdamW and offers a signal-free causal account that CvAdamW's unmatched decay schedules do not exclude.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v1, updated 2026-07-27T03:30:44Z; official arXiv Atom record verified 2026-08-23

novelty_assessment.author_claim: The paper claims the first online use of an attention-specific thermodynamic observable to control AdamW, with a scale-invariant CvAdamW variant that accelerates grokking and turns an early-warning signal into an intervention.
novelty_assessment.evidence: The pinned paper contributes explicit controller equations, three reported detector failures, one favorable single-run comparison, ten paired seeds with a 257-epoch mean gain, and a retrospective 10/10 lead result. However, continuous sensor statistics do not improve the mean, inferential tests disagree, and no signal-free schedule matches the stronger decay dose.
novelty_assessment.reviewer_inference: The defensible novelty is the engineering combination of an existing attention-logit fluctuation proxy with memorization-gated adaptive weight decay, plus transparent reporting of controller failures. The evidence does not establish thermodynamic criticality, prospective early warning, task-invariant scaling, or that C_v rather than generic late weight decay causes the gain; prior and current work already provides mechanistic progress measures, finite-size tests, spectral warnings, optimizer accounts, and an exact weight-decay clock.

reviewer_notes: Secondary verification read all 9 pages of the exact pinned PDF, including equations, every figure and table, discussion, limitations, conclusion, and references. Every reported number was recomputed or checked against Tables 1-2 and the stated seed list. Repairs from the primary reading include correcting Experimental Setup from Section 4 to Section 5, the scale-invariant paired study from Section 6.2 to Section 6.3, schedule strength to Section 6.4, and locating Figure 4 on page 7. The audit distinguishes a one-run in-budget crossing from proof of enabling generalization, a future-selected maximum from an online detector, and matched epochs from matched wall-clock compute. Current competitor search used mechanism/task, evaluation/baseline, and novelty-language query families; exact official arXiv records were checked through 2026-08-23.

verification.passage_check: Independently checked the exact 9-page pinned PDF and extracted text end to end. Verified Equations 1-10; alpha 0.9, gate 0.99, z_thresh 2, all three reported failure epochs/events; the 2-layer/d_model 128/4-head/mod-97 setup; all ten seed rows; means 4313/4056/4333; 257 and 166 epoch effects; every reported p-value, confidence interval and effect size; 2400 +/- 974 lead; both correlations; and 0.8-1.1 versus 1.5-2.6 decay ranges. Corrected stale section anchors and separated retrospective, causal, compute, and finite-size claims.
verification.competitor_check: Re-searched official primary literature with three query families and verified 10 exact-version arXiv records by canonical ID, title, abstract, version URL, and update timestamp. The panel includes thermodynamic foundations, canonical grokking, norm and optimizer mechanisms, mechanistic and information-theoretic progress measures, finite-size and spectral criticality tests, and the subsequent exact weight-decay-clock account; all were current in the official arXiv Atom feed on 2026-08-23.
